display.label: AWS IAM User
display.description: Provision AWS IAM Users with custom paths, permissions boundaries, group memberships, and managed policies

globals.label: AWS Region
globals.description: The AWS region where resources will be provisioned.

resource.key_description: Unique username for the IAM user.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core IAM user settings including username and path hierarchy.

fields.label: User Name
fields.description: The user's name consisting of alphanumeric characters and symbols +=,.@_-

validation.pattern_error: User name must be 1 to 64 characters and contain only alphanumeric characters and symbols +=,.@_-

fields.label: Path
fields.description: Path in which to create the user. Must begin and end with a forward slash (/).

validation.pattern_error: Path must begin and end with a forward slash (/).

sections.label: Permissions & Boundaries
sections.description: Permission boundaries to restrict the maximum permissions this user can obtain.

fields.label: Permissions Boundary ARN
fields.description: The ARN of the managed policy that sets the permissions boundary for the user.

sections.label: Groups & Policies
sections.description: IAM groups and direct policy attachments for this user.

fields.label: Groups
fields.description: IAM groups this user belongs to. Authoritative for this user's membership — don't also add this user to the same group from that group's own Users field, or the two will fight over it on every apply.

fields.label: Managed Policy ARNs
fields.description: Managed policies to attach directly to this user.

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: Resource tags for organizational, tracking, and cost allocation purposes.

fields.label: User Tags
fields.description: Key-value tags assigned to the IAM user.

satellites.note: Group membership is a secondary resource driven by groups, and is only created when the list is non-empty.
Policy attachments are secondary resources driven by managed_policy_arns.
